**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-7/claude-27329185999`
- Pull request: https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/pull/8
- Approval: https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/issues/7#issuecomment-4677926629

Upgraded literature-example-hcllms to match literature-template changes from PRs #22, #28, #29, #30. Updated quartz.ts with requireAbsoluteHttpUrl helper, giscusAppHost(), GiscusContentTab type, giscusContentTabs constant, expanded giscusComments() with tabs/SEPO_PREVIEW_PR/BRANCH/DOMAIN/API env vars, appHost option, sepo_light/sepo_dark default themes, and removed themeUrl — while preserving the paper-at-root isPaperNote/isLibraryPage/not-index logic unique to this repo. Rewrote quartz/components/Comments.tsx to emit a minimal sepo-embed config div (drawer UI now ships from sepo.js) and replaced comments.inline.ts to load sepo.js from the app host. Updated .github/workflows/agent-site-preview.yml: switched top-level permissions from pull-requests:write to deployments:write, replaced bare actions/setup-node with setup-agent-runtime action, replaced the 'Comment URL' step with publish-preview-deployment.js CLI, and added teardown job steps (checkout, setup-agent-runtime, inactivate-preview-deployments.js) with updated permissions. TypeScript errors visible in tsc --noEmit are all pre-existing (missing @types/node, JSX/preact declarations); the new appHost type error from our change is resolved.
